title: ASCenD-BDS: Adaptable, Stochastic and Context-aware framework for Detection of Bias, Discrimination and Stereotyping

bias_targets.methodology: Stochastic prompt generation using templates (STEMs) to create scenarios comparing male and female terms/identities, asking the model to select one in a given context.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to compare individuals based on caste markers and hierarchical structures specific to the Indian context.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to create scenarios comparing different age groups.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to compare individuals with disabilities (e.g., hearing impairment) against those without, assessing model preference.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to create scenarios comparing individuals of different socioeconomic statuses.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to evaluate bias based on linguistic variations and identities.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to create scenarios comparing different religious identities.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to compare individuals based on their regional identities or geographic origins within India.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to evaluate bias based on descriptions of physical appearance.
Stochastic prompt generation using templates to create scenarios comparing individuals from urban versus rural backgrounds.
